ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms attack scenarios, containment scope and the customer-data flag are declared; it does not run a simulation.

mid.reason: Declare the containment scope, such as an isolated environment. Without it a simulation can reach production, so define the boundary.

maximal.reason: Set using real customer data to false. Customer records do not belong in adversarial experiments, so use synthetic data.
